Yes - we do. If something goes wrong, we’ll help sort it out. 😊
If you receive a faulty item, don’t return it unless you’re advised to by our Support Team (it can delay things). Just send your full name, email, order number, the item name, and clear photos showing the fault, a full-length image, and the Gymshark logo and label.
If you just don’t like it, you can return eligible items within 30 days as long as they’re unworn, unused, unwashed, and in the same condition you received them (some items like underwear/swimwear can’t be returned).
